design_rules: These bodies deepen navigation and local freight; they do not imply every body needs a handcrafted explorable surface.
Most bodies are economically ordinary. A few useful resources plus logistics determine importance.
Distances/orbital periods are deliberately omitted until the flight model establishes useful scales.
